description: This PHP test class verifies the functionality of the BuzzAnniversaryDao within the OrangeHRM Buzz plugin, focusing on retrieving upcoming employee anniversaries, including list retrieval and count mechanisms.

classes.name: BuzzAnniversaryDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class to test methods of BuzzAnniversaryDao related to upcoming employee anniversaries.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including creating an instance of BuzzAnniversaryDao and populating test data from fixtures.

methods.name: testGetUpcomingAnniversariesList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of upcoming anniversaries list for specified date filters, asserting correctness of returned data.

methods.name: testGetUpcomingAnniversariesCount
methods.description: Tests counting of upcoming anniversaries for specified date filters, asserting the correctness of count results.
